answer: Split rewards into twenty sequential stages, each unlocked only when the identity broadcasts a fresh signed beacon and finishes a stage task that differs from every earlier one. A farm running a hundred clones must sustain a hundred separate voyages, each with its own cadence and task stream, so one slip at any stage forfeits that alias's entire accrued share. Verification replays each beacon against the task ledger, and a garden of synchronized clones is exposed when their beacon streams correlate. Honest identities complete their voyage once and keep the whole reward.
